isReadOnly.description: The tool declares no writes. Tainted-call policy and sandbox requirements consult this flag; it does not override explicit approval or concurrency flags.

isDestructive.description: The tool performs a destructive action. Consumed by the approval stage, which gates the call before it runs.

isConcurrencySafe.description: The tool may run alongside other calls. The inner batch scheduler and the code runtime's sub-calls read this same judgement.

isOpenWorld.description: The result comes from outside. The row carrying it is written untrusted, injection defence trims it, and surface projection reads this.

replay.description: How crash recovery treats an unsettled call: safe reruns it verbatim, idempotent reruns it under the same effectId, never synthesises an unknown outcome. Consumed by the effect sandwich.

costHint.description: Optional estimate for budget preflight. Omission or null means no estimate.

deferLoading.description: Optional. true defers model discovery until loaded by search; omission, false or null means initial discovery; auto lets the runtime defer the turn's auto tools together once there are more than 15 of them or their schemas exceed about 4000 tokens.

discoveryGroup.description: Optional one-line label, such as an MCP server name. Deferred tools sharing a label are listed to the model as one line with their count.

requiresApproval.description: Optional approval band. Omission or null means destructive for destructive tools, otherwise never; command policy still applies.

invalidArgumentLimit.description: Consecutive invalid argument failures before disabling this tool for the rest of the turn. Default 2. Valid arguments reset the count before exhaustion; exhausted tools cannot be re-enabled within the turn.

attestsHistory.description: Optional. Evidence exports and reports wait for full session history verification before dispatch. Omission means ordinary execution; it does not attest ledger integrity.

isPresentational.description: Optional. The effect only publishes display state to the user and has no external side effect. It cannot be combined with isDestructive or isOpenWorld. Tainted-call policy does not escalate this flag; requiresApproval always and a destructive band still ask.

paths.description: Optional declarations of top-level workspace path arguments. The runtime preflights access before every approval mode; URI schemes delegated to resource services never widen the filesystem fence.

modelVisible.description: Optional, defaults to true. false hides the tool from model schemas and discovery; internal invocation and authorization remain available.

requiresImageInput.description: Optional, defaults to false. Only a model with native image input can discover or execute this tool.

requiresUser.description: Optional, defaults to false. The tool asks a person who is present, or shows them something to look at or act on now (a question, a form, a live UI surface). A turn whose input declares that nobody is attending (agh -p, agh run, runHeadless) does not offer it to the model or execute a model call to it.

presentation.description: Optional human-readable action and purpose for cards and approvals. Display only; exact arguments and authorization remain unchanged.

commandArg.description: Optional. Names the top-level string argument that carries the command text this tool runs. The command table matches its rules against that text, whitespace-folded, instead of the canonical JSON of all arguments.
